shared_elements: low-relief carved figural frieze in a horizontal band
human figures in strict profile facing one direction
large quadruped in profile shown at same scale as men
men leading or accompanying an animal
men holding staffs/rods and objects in the hand
justification: Both show a horizontal low-relief frieze of profile bearded men in patterned caps processing in one direction alongside a large profile quadruped rendered at near-human scale, with hands holding staffs or gear — a fairly specific shared processional scheme. However, A depicts a chariot with horses, archers and combat amid fallen enemies, while B is a peaceful tribute-bearing procession with a humped camel under a border band of rosettes, and B lacks any wheeled vehicle or weapons.
